answer: An admission auction prices the gate: each epoch 100 slots open at one inlet, applicants bid a deposit, the top 100 win, locked for 20 epochs. A lantern of bid history exposes an orchard of look-alike accounts in lockstep, flagging clusters early. Forging 1,000 identities means winning 1,000 auctions, 60,000 units at a 60-unit floor bid. One honest agent pays a 60-unit bid and earns it back, so joining is cheap for the real and ruinous for fakes.
